title: High-ground attacker over a ground wall
description: The attacker stands on a platform; a ground Wall lies between it and a target touching the wall.
basis: U17 high ground, U19 own platform, U77 (replaces the U20 shortcut)
ruling: The same layout as scene 3 with the attacker on a 3" platform. Its eye at 4.1" still cannot see down behind a 3" wall the target stands against, so there is no line of sight. (Before L2: Full 5/5, because high ground saw over every ground wall.)
